signal: GoodShip raised a $25M Series B led by Greenfield Partners in August 2025 and launched Laney, the industry's first AI Transportation Analyst, to scale with enterprise shippers

email.body1:
Derek, saw GoodShip close the $25M Series B and ship Laney, the first AI Transportation Analyst, to go deeper with enterprise shippers.

Scaling that fast usually means more enterprise shippers in play than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for GoodShip off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Derek, quick follow-up for GoodShip.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline jump faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble to recover.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings GoodShip needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Derek, last bit of proof for GoodShip.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how GoodShip's reply rate likely compares to other Series-B startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Derek, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything right after a raise, and the build-and-hire stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a Series-B motion? I'll tailor it to GoodShip either way.
